subjects.title: How NSS feeds encode and deliver ZIA log fields
subjects.lead: Zscaler recommends no more than 50 fields in an NSS feed, to fit syslog message size limits; a SIEM that can ingest larger messages can take more.

subjects.title: Which rule decided a web transaction, from the logs
subjects.lead: `rulelabel` and `ruletype` are filled only when a Block rule applied; an allowed transaction has neither, so an empty `rulelabel` does not mean no rule matched.
